paragraphs.text: A delayed departure at a busy airport can affect flights across a whole continent, because aircraft and crews are often scheduled to fly several routes in a single day. For this reason, airports have become increasingly interested in finding out exactly where time is lost.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Much of the delay happens on the ground rather than in the air. Studies at large European airports found that aircraft often wait with their engines running for ten minutes or more between leaving the gate and taking off, burning fuel and adding to noise.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: One solution is to share information more closely. When airlines, air traffic controllers and ground staff use a single system to plan each departure, aircraft can stay at the gate with engines off until the runway is ready for them.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Passengers themselves also cause delays. Late arrivals at the gate, and bags that must be removed from the hold when a passenger fails to board, can hold up a flight for twenty minutes. Some airports now send text messages reminding passengers to go to the gate.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: The results of these changes have been encouraging but uneven. Airports that introduced shared planning systems reduced average waiting times on the ground, yet delays caused by bad weather or strikes remain largely outside their control.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: A delayed departure at a busy airport can affect flights across a whole continent
keywords: affect flights across a whole continent

explanation.en: One delay affects “flights across a whole continent” because aircraft fly several routes a day → iii.
explanation.kk: Бір кідіріс «flights across a whole continent» әсер етеді, себебі ұшақтар күніне бірнеше бағытпен ұшады → iii.
explanation.ru: Одна задержка затрагивает «flights across a whole continent», потому что самолёты летают по нескольким маршрутам в день → iii.

items.quote: aircraft often wait with their engines running for ten minutes or more

explanation.en: Delays on the ground: aircraft wait “with their engines running” between the gate and take-off → i. Fuel (vi) is mentioned, but not its price.
explanation.kk: Жердегі кідіріс: ұшақтар гейттен шығып, ұшқанға дейін «with their engines running» күтеді → i. Жанармай (vi) аталады, бірақ оның бағасы туралы ештеңе жоқ.
explanation.ru: Задержки на земле: самолёты ждут «with their engines running» между выходом от гейта и взлётом → i. Топливо (vi) упомянуто, но о его цене ничего не сказано.

items.quote: use a single system to plan each departure

explanation.en: Airlines, controllers and ground staff “use a single system to plan each departure” → v “Working together with one plan”.
explanation.kk: Әуе компаниялары, диспетчерлер және жер қызметі «use a single system to plan each departure» → v «Working together with one plan».
explanation.ru: Авиакомпании, диспетчеры и наземные службы «use a single system to plan each departure» → v «Working together with one plan».

explanation.en: “Passengers themselves also cause delays” — late arrivals and bags of no-shows → ii. “Travellers” = “passengers”.
explanation.kk: «Passengers themselves also cause delays» — кешіккен жолаушылар мен ұшпай қалғандардың жүгі → ii. «Travellers» = «passengers».
explanation.ru: «Passengers themselves also cause delays» — опоздавшие и багаж невылетевших пассажиров → ii. «Travellers» = «passengers».

items.quote: The results of these changes have been encouraging but uneven.

explanation.en: “encouraging but uneven” — some problems solved, weather and strikes not → iv. Heading viii catches “bad weather”, but E says nothing about training pilots.
explanation.kk: «encouraging but uneven» — мәселенің бір бөлігі шешілген, ауа райы мен ереуіл шешілмеген → iv. viii тақырыбы «bad weather» сөзіне ілінеді, бірақ E-де ұшқыштарды дайындау туралы сөз жоқ.
explanation.ru: «encouraging but uneven» — часть проблем решена, погода и забастовки — нет → iv. Заголовок viii ловит «bad weather», но о подготовке пилотов в E ни слова.
